title: MOBCAL method file, format 1
description: A method: the buffer gas, the element table, the random number generator, the six run settings and an optional first seed. The file is TOML; this schema checks the document a TOML reader makes of it. docs/methods.md is the specification. The rules that need more than the document are checked by mobcal.methods and listed on that page: a table of one's own must be at its path (a relative one read from the method file's folder) with the SHA-256 given and be a table for the method's gas; the name must differ from the shipped methods' and from every other method in the list; the temperature must be finite; itn x inp x imp is at most 9,999,999; and the name is refused when it holds any character Python's str.isprintable rejects, of which this schema refuses only the controls.

name.description: What the Method list and the run record show: 1 to 60 printable characters, no space at either end.

parameters.description: The element table: a shipped table by name (2012 in either gas, 2000 in helium only), or a table of one's own by path and SHA-256.

temperature.description: The buffer gas temperature in kelvin; 301 when left out.

imp.description: Trajectories per block of the trajectory method; 1000 when left out.

itn.description: Cycles of the trajectory method; 10 when left out.

inp.description: Velocity points of the trajectory method; 40 when left out.

inum.description: Trajectories of the projection approximation and exact hard-sphere pass (helium); 250000 when left out.

inor.description: Reflections followed per hard-sphere trajectory (helium); 30 when left out.

seed.description: The first seed of a run of this method; 5013489, the 2012 seed, when left out.
